title: Video-Based Pelvic Floor Muscle Therapy
official: Utilizing Remote, Video-Based Pelvic Floor Muscle Therapy: A Feasibility Trial
summary: This study is a feasibility, pilot trial of remote, video-based pelvic floor muscle therapy (PFMT) for patients with pelvic floor disorders, including pelvic organ prolapse, urinary incontinence and anorectal dysfunction. PFMT has been shown to improve these symptoms in multiple studies.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of pelvic floor dysfunction with referral for PFR
* English-speaking

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable to access web-based videos
* Unable to speak English
